text:
Alejandra: Heads up — I've cut RC `2026-03-21-rc1` (artifact sha a1b2c3d4). Target promo window 22:00 UTC tonight. Need a short smoke sweep + telemetry sniff before promote. Pinning the artifact now.
Jun: ack. I will run the smoke sweep at +5m and start KV warm after canary. Which batch profile are we using?
Maggie: using `light-latency` batch profile for the canary to keep p95 under 200ms. I’ll run the smoke script and check error rates.
Riya: adding the quick checklist here:
- confirm artifact pin
- smoke sweep (endpoints + health checks)
- kv warm for common prefixes (~10k requests)
- telemetry sniff (latency, 5xx, mem)
- hold for QA ack and deploybot schedule
Alejandra: thanks Riya — pin done. Artifact: `a1b2c3d4`. Marking release notes with notable fixes.
DeployBot: RC created: `2026-03-21-rc1` by Alejandra. Canaries=2, step=10%. Use `/promote` to start promotion.
Jun: smoke command I ran: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --rc=2026-03-21-rc1 --env=staging --concurrency=20``` Results: all endpoints 200, two flaky rates at /search (0.3%), investigating logs.
Maggie: KV warm job queued: `./infra/kv_warm --prefix=/user/cache --requests=10000 --parallel=4`. I'll watch latency during this.
Riya: telemetry sniff in progress — firing queries from three regions, sending traces to Tempo. Watching tokenization spike that caused mem bump yesterday.
Jun: small `/search` flakiness traced to a header edge-case — patch not in RC. Since it's rare and non-blocking, marking as `deferred` in release notes.
Alejandra: decision: proceed with canary but keep rollback cue set. Rollback signal phrase is `--abort-rc1` and we have sheriff on call. If error rate >1% p95 > 500ms or heap OOM alarms, abort immediately.
SRE-Bot: Alert policy: heap_oom HIGH -> notify @SRE-Bot @Alejandra @Jun. Error_rate(5m) > 1% -> Pager.
Maggie: canary deploy started (2 nodes, 10% traffic). Monitoring dashboards now.
DeployBot: Promotion step executed: canary=10% -> scheduled hold 10m. Canary ID `canary-4337-rc1`.
Riya: telemetry: traces look stable, p50/p95 within expected. No new alloc spikes. A couple of unrelated 400s from a client test.
Jun: smoke sweep final: OK. /health, /v1/generate checks green. No 5xx.
Alejandra: QA signoff? @Maggie @Riya please confirm.
Maggie: QA eyeball done. OK to proceed to staged rollout. :thumbsup:
Riya: QA OK. Telemetry green.
Alejandra: promote when ready. Deploy window still valid.
DeployBot: Promotion to 50% in 5m scheduled by Alejandra. Use `/cancel-promo` to stop.
Jun: copying rollback steps in case we need them:
1) run `deploybot rollback --rc=2026-03-21-rc1`
2) pin previous stable `z9y8x7w6` and re-route traffic
3) run post-rollback smoke and clear caches
Alejandra: noted. Sheriff oncall is @Jun. If we see >1% error or latency regressions, Jun triggers rollback.
SRE-Bot: Canary metrics check @ 4m: error_rate=0.18% p95=210ms mem steady. No alarms.
Maggie: starting 50% ramp.
DeployBot: Promotion step executed: 50% -> scheduling final 100% at +10m.
Alejandra: final check at +8m then full promo if all green.
Jun: all green for me.
Riya: telemetry steady.
Maggie: final smoke OK.
DeployBot: Promotion complete: RC `2026-03-21-rc1` promoted to prod (100%). Runbook note: rollback window 30m after full promote.
Alejandra: thanks team. I'll publish release notes now and tag the release. If anything pops, use the rollback phrase. :party_popper:
